$comment: Single source of truth for which bundled scripts each skill ships. Canonical scripts live in .build/scripts/. Run `node .build/sync.mjs` after editing this file or any canonical script to regenerate every skill's scripts/ folder. An entry is either a string (copied to <skill>/scripts/<same-name>) or { "src": "...", "dest": "..." } when the skill expects a different local filename (used to disambiguate same-named variants).
